market_summary: Nifty rose 1.12% to 25,800.60 and Sensex 1.08% to 83,919.71 on Fri 20 Nov, led by banks (Bank Nifty +2.5% to a record) and IT (+1.3%); metals slipped about 0.2% and media fell about 2%. Foreign investors bought ₹10,308 cr (₹32,647 cr for the week, a 15th straight buying day) while domestic funds sold ₹4,860 cr; no India VIX close for Friday was found (it was 16.11 on 19 Nov). Results season is over and no notable company reports today; markets are shut tomorrow (24 Nov, Guru Nanak Jayanti), so this is a short week driven by broker notes, flows and the RBI policy on 4 Dec.

buy_ideas.name: Apollo Hospitals
buy_ideas.target_source: Macquarie (double upgrade to Outperform from Underperform, target raised from ₹6,230), via INDmoney 20 Nov
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 23% to ₹7,615 cr, EBITDA 29% to ₹1,191 cr and profit 32% to ₹630 cr; margin widened to 15.6% from 14.9%. Inpatient volumes +14%, occupancy up to 73%, pharmacy (HealthCo) EBITDA +75%. Stock jumped 5.3% to an all-time high of about ₹9,200 on 20 Nov; Macquarie's ₹10,500 target is about 14% higher, and Motilal had ₹10,400.
buy_ideas.risks: Bought after a 5% one-day jump to a record high, so wait for a dip rather than chasing. Hospital stocks sold off earlier this month on fears of drug-price regulation (Supreme Court query on pharmacy markups); that risk has not gone away.

buy_ideas.name: Eicher Motors
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 20% and profit about 15%. Stock closed ₹8,056 (+4.6%) on 19 Nov as autos rallied 4.4% on cheaper copper and aluminium, which eases the margin worry. Emkay's ₹9,100 target is about 13% above the close.
buy_ideas.risks: EBITDA margin fell 80 bps to 23.7%, and the stock has already jumped in one day; Motilal Oswal is only Neutral at ₹7,420. Metal prices can bounce back. No fresh price found for 20 Nov; ₹8,056 is the 19 Nov close (autos rose about 0.5% on Friday).

buy_ideas.name: Laurus Labs
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up about 33% to ₹2,206 cr, led by CDMO up about 86%; EBITDA ₹750 cr at a 34% margin (up 962 bps) and profit ₹437 cr. Still the cleanest earnings beat on the list; pharma rose 0.6% on 19 Nov.
buy_ideas.risks: Upside to target only about 9%. CDMO orders are lumpy. No fresh price found; ₹2,338 is the broker's reference price, so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: Hitachi Energy India
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 64% and profit up 21%; new orders up 86%, taking the order book to ₹33,300 cr. IDBI sees revenue up 57% in FY27 and margins rising to 16.7% by FY28; target about 25% above the reference price.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is implied from the 17 Nov note (no fresh quote found), so check it. Very expensive stock, and profit grew much slower than revenue.

buy_ideas.name: ABB India
buy_ideas.thesis: September-quarter revenue up 12% and profit up 8%, with a record order book up 36% to about ₹12,900 cr. Two brokers say Buy, targets about 18-20% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Margin fell 70 bps and profit growth was modest; valued at about 60 times 2028 earnings. No fresh price found; ₹6,923 is from the earlier broker notes.
